answer: Propose auctioning ten weekly one-vote licences to assay agents at a 3-token minimum nonrefundable fee each. Each ID delivers a distinct lotus or yarrow spectrum calibrated to a crystal standard. Validators check ID-bound payments and lab-signed ID/week receipts; missing, invalid or reused proof denies the vote without refund. Lab collusion can fake service; wealth can buy all licences. Equipment is reusable capital; fees recur; no stake is locked. One licence backs one ID: ten IDs pay at least 30 tokens/week for at most ten votes, regardless of shared machines or parallel jobs.
